precedents.signature_overlap: Audit analysis daemon confirmed active and consuming CPU; security module in enforcing mode with real denials being logged — both present in INC-2288 and in the current incident.
precedents.divergence: INC-2288 was a CPU-pressure incident on a non-integration host (mid-prod-f3); the current incident carries a host.memory.exhaustion signature and the primary reported symptom is batch latency, not CPU saturation. More critically, the resolution taken in INC-2288 — deactivating the audit event dispatcher — is withdrawn: document_superseded_by reads "Platform security standard SEC-STD-14 (2026-01-30) requires the audit event dispatcher to remain active on production hosts. precedents.falsifying_test: If the audit denial log, when produced, shows no elevated denial volume, the daemon's CPU consumption has a different driver than the one INC-2288 described, and this precedent does not apply.
